details:
The Live in Mars & Moon is an a WebSite that you can create or simulate bases in mars & Moon. The official website is made in Webador.es , a page that you can create Websites, use a domain to be public, put embed code and more things to create a web.

In the website (especificly the slide "crear") there is a chat-bot made in n8n (check the image and check the repository of github for more info) that you can create or simulate analog base to be on the future in the moon or mars, is it powered by a API key of Gemini 3.8 Flash that use DATA time-real information to anwers the cuestions that are used to create your proyect, in the center of all (the Live) there is the system prompt to make the cuestions and do the official information about your proyect, it has a simple memory to store DATA and the conversation do not lose, it has a RAG that is a 166 Information about ALL of mars and moon, is has an embbeding of Google Gemini (or Gemini embbedings) and it has a call of another workflow that is the creator of the images that are going to appear when the chat-bot ends the all questionary about your simulation/proyect, The workflow that call to create images is powered by Gemini Nano Banana 2.5 flash, and image creator, then the images go to a website that host the images and then return then to the chat-bot, the page that host this is cloudinary.com, it has for benefits that before going to the mars and moon we can simulate the model that are to similar to mars & moon for example the Atacama dessert is a good option to simulate an analog base to in the future contruct there in mars.

our proyect is simple, it has recomentadions if you are not expert of all the space or mars/moon, the chat-bot fixed that giving recomendations in the questionary and it is so easy to made proyects for future misions to the moon or mars...
